thread:
maria: Starting RC-12 creation now. artifact: rc-2026.03-12 (sha: b3f9a1d). Can someone sanity-check release notes and rollback plan?
jon: Looking. Running smoke suite against staging now. ETA ~4m.
jon: smoke: all green except redis KV warm stage showing 503s on first two requests. investigating.
lee: KV warm step needs prefix load; I can run a warm job right after pin.
maria: Good — we should finish pin + canary sequence only after KV warm succeeds.
tess: Release notes draft: "RC-12: batching optimizations, small API surface tweak, improve routing policy for fallback." Adding known issue about a transient 503 during initial KV warm.
jon: smoke suite OK now after warm job. latency p95 stayed under 180ms for text-generation route.
sheriff-oncall: FYI I'll be on-call during promo window 16:00-18:00 UTC. If rollback needed, I'll be the decision owner.
maria: Rollback plan: immediate rollback to rc-11 (artifact rc-2026.02-23 sha: a7c2b9f). Steps: 1) revert traffic to rc-11 100% via deploybot, 2) run smoke, 3) postmortem. Approve?
lee: +1. Confirmed rc-11 passes post-smoke.
jon: I also added a temporary telemetry guard to stop promo if error rate > 1% for 5m.
maria: OK pinning artifact now. Command:```
deploybot pin --artifact rc-2026.03-12 --env prod --by maria --reason "RC-12 promo"
```
deploy-bot: Received pin request for rc-2026.03-12. Verifying artifacts...
deploy-bot: Artifact verification OK. Pinned to candidate slot.
maria: Initiating staged promo: 5% canary for 10m -> 25% 15m -> 100% 10m. jon will watch telemetry.
tess: Release notes link: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/rc-12-notes (draft). Please add any glaring callouts.
jon: Starting canary step: routing 5% to rc-12.
deploy-bot: Promo step started. canary=5% duration=10m. tracking id=promo-4312345678.
jon: First 3 minutes: error rate 0.03%, latency stable. No spike on DB.
lee: KV cache looks warm, no 503s on initial prefixes. Good.
sheriff-oncall: Acknowledge. Standby for rollback lurch.
maria: Move to 25% after 10m.
jon: 10m passed, error rate steady. Increasing to 25%.
deploy-bot: Updating traffic to 25%.
jon: 5m into 25%: noticed slight uptick in rerank latency for session-id prefix group, investigating.
lee: digging — looks like model variant selection fallback caused longer kernel path for a small subset. Hotfix options: (a) revert traffic, (b) reduce canary to 10% and continue monitoring, (c) patch quick config to force faster kernel.
maria: Decision: drop back to 10% for now and enable telemetry alert to 0.5% error threshold. Keep sheriff in loop.
sheriff-oncall: agreed. If latency doesn't normalize in 10m -> rollback.
jon: Rolling traffic to 10%. deploy-bot: executing.
deploy-bot: Traffic updated to 10%.
jon: Monitoring... error rate dropped back to baseline, rerank latency improving.
maria: Ok proceed to 50% after 10m check.
jon: 10m ok, moving to 50%.
deploy-bot: Traffic updated to 50%.
jon: 5m: small noise, but telemetry guard not tripped.
lee: Pushing a non-disruptive config to prefer the faster kernel for fallback variants (no model swap). Should reduce tail latencies.
lee: config rolled, confirmed on canary nodes.
jon: latency tail now aligned. No error spikes.
maria: Ready for full promotion. Any objections?
tess: +1 from product. Watch docs for client-facing note about minor behavior change in reranking ordering.
sheriff-oncall: +1. We'll trigger rollback immediately if SLOs break.
maria: Promoting to 100%. Command:```
# final promotion
deploybot promote --artifact rc-2026.03-12 --env prod --staged false --by maria --notes "RC-12 full promo"
```
deploy-bot: Promotion started. moving traffic to rc-2026.03-12. expected completion ~3m.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete. All prod routes now at rc-2026.03-12.
jon: Post-promo smoke: all checks green. p999 tail latency within expected.
lee: KV warm persisted, no cold-start issues.
maria: Publishing release notes and tagging in repo. Link: https://git.redwood/release-notes/rc-12
tess: Added client note and changelog entry.
sheriff-oncall: I'm staying on call for 60m; will trigger rollback if error rate > 0.7% sustained 5m.
maria: Thanks team. Closing promo thread. If anyone sees anything weird, ping in #eng-oncall and escalate. :tada:
